item.title: Lilly Q1 2026 Earnings and Obesity Portfolio
item.description:
• Summary: Lilly reported strong Q1 2026 revenue growth of 56%, driven by obesity drugs Zepbound (tirzepatide) and the launch of its oral GLP-1 pill Foundayo (orforglipron). However, declining prices and lack of specifics on pill sales caused some concern. CEO highlighted competition from amylin rivals.
  • MoAs: Tirzepatide: GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonist. Orforglipron: oral GLP-1 receptor agonist.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Pharma, BioPharma Dive, BioSpace, Endpoints News, BioSpace

item.title: Merck Pipeline and Earnings
item.description:
• Summary: Merck discontinued an early-stage TROP-2 ADC while keeping deal doors open as Keytruda patent cliff approaches. It announced a deal with Terns for a leukemia drug, and reported mixed trends for growth products Winrevair and Ohtuvayre in its Q1 2026 earnings.
  • MoAs: TROP-2 ADC: antibody-drug conjugate targeting TROP-2. Winrevair (sotatercept): activin signaling inhibitor. Ohtuvayre (ensifentrine): dual PDE3/4 inhibitor.
  • Sources: BioSpace, BioPharma Dive, Fierce Pharma

item.title: Bristol Myers Squibb (BMS) Pipeline and Strategy
item.description:
• Summary: BMS highlighted growth products overtaking the legacy portfolio, with Camzyos facing competition. Analysts focused on three key programs, including Cobenfy (KarXT), positioned as a safer alternative for Alzheimer's psychosis ahead of pivotal data. The company ended a Zymeworks collaboration on a phase 1 cancer bispecific.
  • MoAs: Camzyos (mavacamten): cardiac myosin inhibitor. Cobenfy (xanomeline-trospium): muscarinic receptor agonist (xanomeline) and anticholinergic (trospium).
  • Sources: Fierce Pharma, Endpoints News, BioSpace, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Avalyn IPO and Respiratory Drugs
item.description:
• Summary: Avalyn priced its IPO at an upsized $300M to fund development of reformulated respiratory drugs for pulmonary fibrosis, including an inhaled version of Esbriet (pirfenidone) or Ofev (nintedanib). The company aims to improve tolerability and efficacy.
  • MoAs: Pirfenidone: antifibrotic (TGF-β inhibitor). Nintedanib: tyrosine kinase inhibitor (VEGFR/PDGFR/FGFR). The reformulation likely retains these MoAs with improved pharmacokinetics.
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech, BioPharma Dive

item.title: Lilly Lawsuit Against Empower
item.description:
• Summary: A court dismissed part of Eli Lilly's lawsuit against compounding pharmacy Empower, but allowed some claims to proceed. The lawsuit involves alleged improper compounding of Lilly's drugs.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News

item.title: AstraZeneca Pipeline Changes
item.description:
• Summary: AstraZeneca is pruning its asthma and rare disease pipeline while cultivating its cancer portfolio. Additionally, the company acquired an EGFR degrader from Pinetree for $25 million.
  • MoAs: EGFR degrader: induces degradation of epidermal growth factor receptor. Asthma and rare disease drugs: undisclosed.
  • Sources: BioSpace, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Deals and Acquisitions
item.description:
• Summary: XTL Bio agreed to acquire a psychedelic biotech, while Wuxi AppTec reported a Q1 revenue rise. Leo Pharma paid $50 million to Replay for a preclinical skin disease gene therapy. BeOne struck a $2 billion deal to option a preclinical trispecific antibody from China's Huahui.
  • MoAs: N/A (specific mechanisms not disclosed in article titles).
  • Sources: Endpoints News, Fierce Biotech, Fierce Biotech

item.title: Novartis US Manufacturing
item.description:
• Summary: Novartis unveiled a new factory in North Carolina, the final new build in the company's $23 billion US manufacturing pledge. The facility will support production of innovative medicines.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Endpoints News
